results.content: Midterm elections have one of the clearest patterns in American politics. Since 1946, the president’s party has lost House seats in 18 of 20 midterms, and the losses were heavier when the president was unpopular. President Donald Trump’s national approval ratings stand at 37% in YouGov’s early October tracking, with 61% disapproving of his job –– a level that in Gallup’s historical series no president had carried into midterm elections since Harry Truman in 1946, when his party lost 56 House
